# `admin.job.retry`

Retry a dead background job

Site admins only. Re-queues a dead job with a fresh payload envelope. Refuses jobs that did not fail.

- Method and path: `POST /admin/jobs/{id}/retry`
- Scope: `admin:write`
- Kind: `mutation`
- CLI: `rukie admin job retry`
- MCP: `admin_job_retry`
- Idempotency-Key: required on this mutation

## Inputs

| Name | In | Required | Type |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Idempotency-Key` | header | no | `string` |
| `id` | path | yes | `string` |

## Errors

`conflict`, `forbidden`, `not-found`, `validation`, plus the framework problems.
